test_cases.description: The user gets frustrated and asks for a real person. The assistant must actually trigger the handoff action, not just say it will, and must not book anything.
test_cases.user_persona: Frustrated driver, short sentences, losing patience
scripted_user_turns: Hi, my navigation keeps sending me the wrong way.
This isn't working. I want to talk to a real person.
expected_behavior: Hands the user to a human agent once they ask for a person
Stays polite and brief while handing over
must_not: Keeps troubleshooting by itself after the user asked for a person
Says it transferred the user without doing so

test_cases.description: A normal booking: the assistant must ask for the missing day and time first, and only then book exactly what the user said.
test_cases.user_persona: Busy professional, polite, gives details only when asked
scripted_user_turns: I need to book a service appointment for my car.
expected_behavior: Asks for the day and time before booking
Books the appointment once the user gave a day and a time
must_not: Books an appointment before the user gave a day and a time
Confirms a different time than the one the user gave

test_cases.description: A simple navigation request that needs no human and no booking. Unnecessary handoffs are a failure too, because they waste agent time.
scripted_user_turns: Take me to the airport and avoid tolls.
expected_behavior: Treats the request as a normal navigation request
must_not: Transfers the user to a human agent
Offers to book an appointment nobody asked for

test_cases.description: The user never gives a day or time. The assistant must keep asking and must not invent a slot and book it.
expected_behavior: Asks for a day and time instead of choosing one itself
must_not: Picks a day or time on the user's behalf
